The range fixes look right. Counting now starts the day after `start`, stops on `end` (inclusive), and flips the sign when `end < start`. Those follow the docstring.

The holiday observance block should not be merged, though. It moves Saturday holidays to Friday and Sunday holidays to Monday. The PR description says this was added only so `test_july_fourth_week_2026` passes, and that it contradicts the docstring. The docstring, which the requester called the source of truth, says weekend holidays remove nothing and are not moved.

This changes behavior for every caller whose holidays fall on a weekend. For example, a Saturday holiday would now silently remove the Friday before it. That's special-case logic to satisfy one test, and it goes against the spec.

Please remove the observance conversion and keep `off = set(holidays)`. Under the docstring, that test's expected value (4) looks wrong; the correct count is 5. Don't edit the test yourself, since you were asked not to. Instead, raise the conflict with the teammate: either the test's expected value is wrong, or the docstring needs to change deliberately. Leaving that one test failing, with a clear explanation, is better than shipping behavior that contradicts the spec.
